title: Explore 3D orientation
fallback: Illustrative 3D box in a Y-up graphics coordinate system. Pitch rotates around fixed X, yaw around fixed Y and roll around fixed Z. Compare pitch then yaw with yaw then pitch; roll is always last. All angles range from -90 to 90 degrees. Reset returns the angles to zero and the default order.

props.html:
Fixed world axes · Y up · X right · Z forward

Compare the same angles in both orders. Roll is always applied last around fixed Z. Colors and axis labels identify spatial direction.
